# Film Hunt. ## Browse top rated movies by genre and year. Launch tags:Video Streaming•Movies•Streaming Services. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Film Hunt. AppSignal — Get full visibility into app health, errors, and performance. Get full visibility into app health, errors, and performance. Finding \*good\* movies to watch has been a pet peeve of mine for a while now. I always seemed to default to using IMDB, which is clunky and hard to use. So as little side project we whipped up Film Hunt - which organises IMDBs top rankings by genre, year and makes them nice to look at. Hope you guys enjoy it :). I see you link through to apple store / itunes - can you link through to youtube also? I often chromecast these movies - useful app tho thanks. Guys, some silent gems would be missing. And the older period recommendations are pretty standard. This wouldn't pass if the intended audience are true cinephiles, these recommendations are Film Class 101. BUT - pre-1990 is not ages ago... @bramk Haha well there's a few requests to add 80's in, so that would give you another 10 years leeway! Can you explain the ranking? It just uses descending IMDB rankings filtering on genre & year. For some reason it occasionally gets rankings slightly out of order (e.g. 8.7 appearing after 8.6) which is weird, but as it's a side project I haven't really had time to look into it. It's on the bug list :) @patrickedgett. This is exactly what I needed. Same here @v4violetta 😄 Great job! You are most welcome @v4violetta @xzarexhc. This goes to my bookmarks :) Thanks.
